text:
Michelle (support): Hey team — Customer (acct_6432) says we clicked "Grant free trial" from the support console but their credit balance didn't change. UI showed a green success toast. Can someone check backoffice? :thinking:

Jenna (cs): Customer says they tried API key in prod, still 0 credits. They need this resolved ASAP, trial expiry in 6h.

Michelle (support): I pulled the audit log: support-console recorded an action with correlation `c=gr-0a1b2c`. Entry says status=accepted. Backoffice job log shows a processing error right after accept. Pasting snippet: 

```
2026-03-15T09:11:02Z INFO grant-worker received job id=gw-9823 payload={acct:acct_6432, amt:5000, src:support-console, corr:c=gr-0a1b2c}
2026-03-15T09:11:02Z ERROR grant-worker processing failed: DBDeadlockError: deadlock detected on table billing_ledger (try 1)
  at grant_processor.applyGrant (/srv/backoffice/dist/grant_processor.js:214:27)
  at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:95:5)
```

Olivia (backoffice): Huh. I see the grant queue consumer spiked errors and the retry policy exhausted (we only retry 3x). The job status is now `failed` in grant-jobs table. No automatic rollback ran because we never got to ledger write?

Raj (eng-oncall): Can you paste the grant-jobs row and the ledger row (if created)? Also check redis latency and PG locks around that timestamp.

Michelle (support): grant-jobs row: id=gw-9823, status=failed, attempts=3, last_error="DBDeadlockError". There is no ledger row for acct_6432 and that correlation id.

Raj (eng-oncall): Repro steps for the team:
1) From support console, click Grant -> fill fields (acct_6432, 5000) -> submit.
2) Or run curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.local/admin/grants \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"account_id":"acct_6432","amount":5000,"source":"support-console","correlation_id":"c=gr-0a1b2c"}'
```
This will enqueue a job to `grant-queue`.

Olivia (backoffice): Quick diagnostics I ran:
- grant-worker service was running but CPU was high — seems like a transient PG lock storm from concurrent billing writes (we had a large billing migration ongoing at 09:10).
- Redis queue backlog momentarily hit 800. Some old jobs were stuck.
- Our retry policy marks job failed after 3 attempts and we don't surface failed jobs to console.

Raj (eng-oncall): Short-term mitigation:
- Olivia, can you restart the grant-worker consumer and requeue failed job gw-9823 with backoff?
- Michelle, tell the customer we are applying credits manually and will follow up within 30m.

(backoffice-bot): Automated action: grant-worker restarted by olivia-backoffice at 2026-03-15T09:26:12Z.

Olivia (backoffice): Requeued gw-9823, set attempts=0 and scheduled at +10s. I also bumped worker concurrency to 2 temporarily to drain backlog.

Raj (eng-oncall): I'll add a quick guard in grant_processor to detect deadlock and switch to linear retry with jitter (instead of exhausting) and emit a monitoring alert when a job reaches attempts=3. Also add a failed-job view in console.

Jenna (cs): Thanks. Customer is on hold. Please confirm when credits applied so I can let them resume.

(10m later)

Olivia (backoffice): gw-9823 processed successfully. Ledger row created: ledger_id=ldg-5512, amount=5000, acct=acct_6432, correlation=c=gr-0a1b2c. Customer balance updated.

Michelle (support): Confirmed with customer — balance now shows 5000 and they could create embeddings. Marking incident resolved for now.

Raj (eng-oncall): Follow-ups (action items):
- Olivia/eng-platform: add visibility for failed grant jobs in support console (P0 for next sprint).
- Platform: add a transient-deadlock retry policy in grant-worker (hotfix deployed).
- SRE: investigate billing migration overlap with grant-worker and adjust migration batching.
- CS: confirm no other accounts affected (Jenna to run a quick audit).

Jenna (cs): Running audit for grants between 09:05-09:20, will post any anomalies. :mag:

Michelle (support): leaving ticket note: manual apply done via backoffice requeue, communication sent. Closing thread unless audit finds more. :white_check_mark:

(reacts: :thumbsup: from raj-eng-oncall, :eyes: from olivia-backoffice)
